# Dockio

> Dockio Technosolutions Private Limited is an enterprise AI strategy, implementation and systems-integration company based in Mumbai, India. Dockio is an OpenAI Select Partner.

Dockio serves banking and financial services, pharma and life sciences, logistics and supply chain, IT and software, and retail and consumer goods.

## Services

- [Enterprise AI services](https://www.dockio.in/services/): Strategy, implementation, embedded specialists and adoption support.
- [AI implementation](https://www.dockio.in/services/integration/): AI workflows connected to enterprise information, tools and systems.
- [Embedded AI teams](https://www.dockio.in/services/embedded-ai-teams/): AI engineering, architecture, product, evaluation and adoption specialists.
- [AI strategy and prioritisation](https://www.dockio.in/services/strategy/): Opportunity assessment, operating readiness and implementation planning.
- [AI adoption and value](https://www.dockio.in/services/adoption/): Workflow improvement, adoption and operating performance.
- [Agentic workflows](https://www.dockio.in/services/workflows/): Business workflows involving AI, information sources, tools and human review.
- [Implementation sprint](https://www.dockio.in/services/implementation-sprint/): A scoped implementation engagement for a business workflow.

Sankalp Shirish More is Dockio's Founder and Director. His six years of professional experience span enterprise AI platforms in banking and AI engineering in life sciences and consumer goods. He holds an MSc in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Mumbai.
